column3: [confused] Huh? Is that a tooth up there? How did it get stuck there?
[puzzled] And why are they putting a gold chain on it?
[screaming] Ow! Stop! You're gonna rip my head off!
Dude, I think they're pulling him down here, next to us.
[scared, confused] Wait... where am I? What is this place?
[reassuring] Relax, buddy. In a few months, you'll be hanging out down here with us.
[wincing] Thanks, Doc. But that really hurt!
You had an impacted canine, stuck under your gum and bone.
We uncovered the tooth, bonded a small button and chain to it, and hooked it to your braces to gently pull it down.
At each visit, we'll adjust the tension, until the tooth slowly moves into place.
